## Definition of done

- [ ] CI green: Detekt, Lint, Konsist, unit + Room migration tests, Roborazzi diff, coverage report
- [ ] New or changed UI has light / dark / 200 % font-scale screenshots (Roborazzi baselines updated deliberately)
- [ ] Tests name the requirement ids they cover (`FR_…` / `NFR_…`)
- [ ] No `TODO` without an issue link
- [ ] Docs 02–05 still describe reality, or an ADR records the deviation
- [ ] Security-sensitive change (keys, network, exported components, backups)? Reviewed against doc 02 §9
